120 systems with images. Without images yet: HD 166, HD 1461, HD 8907, HD 11413, HD 12467, HD 19994, HD 23484, HD 25821, HD 27290, HD 30422, HD 30495, HD 31295, HD 31392, HD 32977, HD 37594, HD 38529, HD 45184, HD 48370, HD 50554, HD 52265, HD 69830, HD 70313, HD 71722, HD 82943, HD 90089, HD 95698, HD 102647, HD 110897, HD 113337, HD 128311, HD 138965, HD 141133, HD 141378, HD 142091, HD 143894, HD 153053, HD 158643, HD 159492, HD 165908, HD 176894, HD 183324, HD 187897, HD 189002, HD 192263, HD 192425, HD 202206, HD 216435, GJ 581, MP Mus; plus 28 systems resolved only at low resolution (mostly Herschel), listed in the database without images.
Far-IR is incomplete. Herschel/PACS resolves most belts only marginally (beam ≈ 6–10″), giving little structural information beyond a rough radius. Only images from Booth+2013, Moór+2015 and Moór+2020 are included; ~65 Herschel-only systems from the Pawellek compilation are in the database without images.
